Pinned sources:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data/68d10a4b21150cae5e1ebbd223eed289cf32d90c/data/%E8%89%BE.json
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data/68d10a4b21150cae5e1ebbd223eed289cf32d90c/data/%E8%BE%BE.json

The data was derived by Make Me a Hanzi from fonts provided by Arphic
Technology Co., Ltd. Copyright (C) 1999 Arphic Technology Co., Ltd.
It is redistributed under the Arphic Public License. The complete, unmodified
license is included in ARPHICPL.TXT. The data retains its original license;
this repository does not relicense the character data as MIT.

Each JSON contains strokes (SVG outlines), medians (ordered pen centerlines)
and radStrokes (zero-based radical stroke indices). The order of strokes and
medians is the character's writing order. There are no external runtime URLs.

Coordinates use a 1024 by 1024 box. Upper-left is (0, 900), lower-right is
(1024, -124), and y decreases downward. To map to a downward-positive unit
square, use x / 1024 and (900 - y) / 1024 for both outlines and median points.

Format documentation and upstream lineage:
https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi#graphics-txt-keys
https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data#license

The name lessons follow these median paths and use the same brush.js geometry
as live writing. Foundation lessons reveal the actual source outline along
its median. The displayed outline is a writing reference. Scoring uses the
source path and the selected live brush's reachable widths. Scoring is local
geometric feedback, not professional calligraphy assessment. No Hanzi Writer
library source code is bundled; only static character-data assets are used.

Foundation stroke models added 2026-11-06
The model-*.json files are additional unmodified character data copied from
the same pinned Hanzi Writer Data commit and retain the Arphic Public License.
- dist/data/model-yi.json: upstream data/一.json (U+4E00).
- dist/data/model-er.json: upstream data/二.json (U+4E8C).
- dist/data/model-san.json: upstream data/三.json (U+4E09).
- dist/data/model-shi.json: upstream data/十.json (U+5341).
- dist/data/model-shang.json: upstream data/上.json (U+4E0A).
- dist/data/model-zhong.json: upstream data/中.json (U+4E2D).
- dist/data/model-ren.json: upstream data/人.json (U+4EBA).
- dist/data/model-ba.json: upstream data/八.json (U+516B).
- dist/data/model-qian.json: upstream data/千.json (U+5343).

- dist/data/model-kou.json: upstream data/口.json (U+53E3).
- dist/data/model-ri.json: upstream data/日.json (U+65E5).
- dist/data/model-ding.json: upstream data/丁.json (U+4E01).
- dist/data/model-xiao.json: upstream data/小.json (U+5C0F).
- dist/data/model-shui.json: upstream data/水.json (U+6C34).
- dist/data/model-chuo.json: upstream data/辶.json (U+8FB6).

foundation-models.json is site-authored selection metadata: character asset,
zero-based stroke index, descriptive label, sampled curve bounds in the source
coordinate system [minX,minY,maxX,maxY], and uniform display scale. It does not
modify the original outlines or medians. Display bounds use 400 samples per
Bezier segment. The source outlines are font-derived teaching references,
not facsimiles of a named calligrapher or classical stele. Since v1.19.0 the
original outline supplies the visible foundation demonstration. The guide
reveals it in the direction of the source median. Live writing is drawn by
the pressure- and speed-sensitive brush and does not clip to the outline.
Teaching reference for basic regular-script brushwork: Zhang Hengguo,
Introduction to Middle School Calligraphy, Tsinghua University Press, ch. 4.
https://www.tup.tsinghua.edu.cn/upload/books/yz/096910-01.pdf

Additional whole-word lesson assets added 2026-11-06
- dist/data/word-shan.json: upstream data/山.json (U+5C71), 3 strokes.
- dist/data/word-yue.json: upstream data/月.json (U+6708), 4 strokes.
These are also verbatim files from the same pinned upstream commit and license.
Whole-word courses reuse existing model-da-big.json (大), model-xiao.json (小),
model-shui.json (水), and model-ri.json (日), without duplicate data assets.

- dist/data/name-lai.json: upstream data/莱.json (U+83B1), 10 ordered strokes.
These files are copied byte-for-byte from the same pinned upstream commit
and retain the Arphic Public License, unchanged from the original assets.
